title: Look for Abandoned Vaults
author: Kirpini OrangeVillager2
pages:
Hello friend! I want to tell you about abandoned vaults.
When a bank gets destroyed or abandoned, a part of its vault often survives.
I strongly recommend that you go looking for them, you can find an immense number of emeralds in these locations.
These structures are almost always burned in the ground, but there are ways to find them.
Firstly, the land above them is often oddly shaped and flat. This is because the ground above is newer and fits the shape of the vault. Once you find one, you can see the pattern.
Secondly, you can find a map to them. Most banks sell one copy for a large sum of emeralds. They won’t sell it to you unless they like you enough though since they only have one copy.
Go exploring and see what riches you can find.
